title: Prometheus-alpha v0.7: is there a causal trade-off between tolerating noise and surviving cell loss?
status: Locked before any v0.7 measurement. T0, T1, N0, N1, C0 and C1 were training when this was locked. No pilots; code smoke tests at n = 2-4 checked shapes and initial losses only (the noise stress was softened from sigma 0.5-2 to 0.25-1 after its initial anatomy loss, 4.1, showed it destroyed the body; disclosed here).
motivation: v0.6 post hoc: across six rules, head-memory noise tolerance correlated -0.83 with memory after cell turnover. A correlation over six rules from two lineages could be lineage, not trade-off. v0.7 intervenes.

rules.T0, T1: S0 / S1 + 1,000 iterations with a 60-step stress segment after the delay: three times, 10% of cells die at random, then 20 steps
rules.N0, N1: the same with Gaussian noise (sigma uniform 0.25-1) added to every living cell's hidden channels instead
rules.C0, C1: the same with no perturbation (control for the extra training)
rules.shared: same seed and the same sampled lives for the three siblings of a lineage; memory scored after the stress and after a wound (S objective)

measures.turnover_memory: 10% of cells die every 20 steps for 200 steps after learning (kill seed 2, cohort seed 8025, 128 worms)
measures.noise_memory: Gaussian noise sigma 1.5 (seed 3) on the hidden channels of head sites 4-11 of intact trained worms, then 12 steps (cohort seed 8030, 128 worms)

H33.claim: Trade-off: hardening against cell loss costs noise tolerance

H34.claim: Trade-off: hardening against noise costs survival of cell loss

decision_rules.family: H31-H34 within each lineage; Holm at alpha 0.05; SESOI 0.10; replicated = supported in both lineages
decision_rules.interpretation: The trade-off is supported causally only if H33 or H34 replicates. If H31 and H32 hold but H33 and H34 do not, the v0.6 correlation was not a trade-off: both robustnesses can be had together.

predictions.H31: lineage 1: supported; lineage 0: not supported (S0 already keeps ~0.9 under turnover, little headroom)
predictions.H33: not supported in either lineage (our bet: the v0.6 correlation reflects lineage, not a causal trade-off)
